title: Everyone Ai
one_liner: Self-service AI workspace platform for launching Claude Code environments via Kubernetes
what_it_is: A web portal and CLI tool that allows teams to provision isolated VS Code workspaces backed by Claude Code. It abstracts Kubernetes complexity, letting users launch pre-configured development environments from a browser catalog without local setup or credential management.
how_its_built: The system consists of a Node.js Express backend serving a vanilla JS SPA frontend. It interacts with a k3s Kubernetes cluster using the official k8s client to dynamically create and manage Workspace pods (running code-server) and Target pods. An 'afterburner' CLI handles infrastructure bootstrapping and Helm chart deployment.
how_to_apply: Operators use the afterburner CLI to bootstrap a Linux VM into a k3s cluster and deploy the portal via Helm. End-users connect via VPN, access the portal URL, select a template from the App Catalog, and receive a browser-based VS Code instance with Claude Code ready in the terminal.
quickstart:
npx afterburner bootstrap --host <ip> --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
npx afterburner install
helm install everyone-ai-portal ./charts/portal -f profiles/k3s.yaml -f config.yaml --namespace myteam --create-namespace
features: App Catalog with pre-configured Claude Code templates
One-click launch of personal VS Code workspaces in browser
Automated k3s cluster bootstrapping via SSH
Team-wide usage monitoring and fleet overview
Persistent HTTPS endpoints for deployed targets
Zero-config user onboarding via VPN access
